findings.title: New financing bridge is supported; current funding sufficiency remains unaccepted
findings.finding: The issuance closed for $4,750m face. Estimated net receipts and annual new-note coupon reconcile. The capitalization table is an issuance-only adjustment to June, retains the $875m tranche and cannot prove October cash or settlement. The study expressly preserves these limits.
findings.proposed_correction: No correction to frozen historical foundation required. Obtain actual receipts/use of proceeds, old-note settlement and intervening flows before a current funding conclusion.
findings.outcome: Accepted only as historical and conditional foundation; full current funding bridge remains incomplete.

findings.title: A later debt bridge must include old-note coupons as well as principal
findings.finding: The frozen illustration deliberately deducts only $875m principal and explicitly excludes interest. If outstanding for the regular period, the September24 coupons are $18.4275m on the $875m tranche and $13.496875m on the $625m tranche. Neither payment nor nonpayment is established. The new $240m annual coupon is not total company debt service.
findings.proposed_correction: Use an event-dated schedule of all actual and conditional coupons, principal and any redemption terms in downstream work; retain the present illustrative label.
findings.outcome: Nonblocking for this foundation; required before a numerical holding-window bridge.

findings.title: Commitments are not a single incremental debt subtraction
evidence: June27 10-Q Notes8-10; cash-flow pp6-7; liquidity p28
findings.finding: The $30,276m commitments buy inputs/capacity and overlap operating cash flows. Lease, guarantee and investment amounts have different triggers and dates. Adding every gross amount to debt would overstate immediate funding need; deleting them because CFO is positive would understate forward cash and tail risk. Counterparty/contract mapping is unresolved and disclosed.
findings.proposed_correction: Before forecasting, map each obligation to cash period, counterparty, cancellation/assignment terms and amounts already captured in operating/capex/lease cash; do not assume overlap means no incremental exposure.
findings.outcome: Treatment accepted; quantitative overlap and near-term payment adequacy remain unaccepted.

findings.title: Short-term investments are usable assets with realization assumptions, not identical to immediate cash
evidence: June27 10-Q Note8 fair-value and maturity tables
findings.finding: The $17,837.3875m illustration correctly combines cash and short-term investments while excluding restricted cash and restricted long-term securities. An executable funding schedule must still model maturities/sales, market value and settlement timing; the Note8 total available-for-sale portfolio includes longer maturities. No haircut or loss is evidenced or invented here.
findings.proposed_correction: Keep cash and investments separate in a subsequent payment schedule and document realistic liquidation assumptions.
findings.outcome: Nonblocking for the dated aggregate illustration; no current surplus is accepted.

findings.title: Conditional warrants and variable acquisition shares must remain coupled to business economics
findings.finding: The 320m warrant maximum, $3.2m exercise cash and dated 83.6105459% old-owner fraction reconcile. No June vesting is not no October vesting. Higher purchase volumes can increase profits and dilution simultaneously; failure to vest can coexist with excess committed capacity. World Labs consideration is stock with a future pricing window; neither a current-share-count substitution nor an $8.2bn cash deduction is justified.
findings.proposed_correction: Model operational cash, vesting, employee claims and acquisition cash/benefits/shares together; verify actual dates and terms before per-share conclusions.
findings.outcome: Conditional algebra accepted; current diluted claims, acquisition benefits and investment attractiveness unaccepted.

findings.title: Requested Astra High route is recorded; actual backend identity is not independently verified
findings.finding: This is an actual separate-worker evidence review, not a relabelled author test. The dispatch requested Astra High, but this worker has no independent model-name, reasoning-effort or speed telemetry. No different model identity is inferred.
findings.proposed_correction: Parent must preserve requested-versus-verified identity and resolve whether dispatch evidence satisfies the workflow gate; do not claim independently verified Astra execution from this report.
findings.outcome: Substantive independent review complete. Economic scope accepted as stated; backend-verified stronger-model certification not asserted.
